description: Change ONLY the healed SCARS around the mouth: a clearly readable dark-brown jagged scar line extends from EACH corner of the closed lips across BOTH cheeks toward ears. Add several short perpendicular stitch-like scar marks crossing each line. These wide old healed Glasgow-smile scars are the identifying feature and must remain readable at native pixel scale. No blood, no moustache, no beard, no fresh wounds. Preserve aviator sunglasses, clean-shaven narrow face, dark swept-back side-part hair, entire suit, exact height and body proportions, front pose and hands. Same pixel style and transparent background; no outer gray halo.
